//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Fixed Anvil Repair Cost -> Config

Enable Fixed Anvil Repair Cost.//: Whether Fixed Anvil Repair Cost is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

repairCostLevelAmount.//: The amount of level it costs to repair an item on an anvil. A value of 0 keeps vanilla behaviour. min: 0, max: 100

repairCostMaterialAmount.//: The amount of material it costs to repair an item on an anvil. A value of 0 keeps vanilla behaviour. min: 0, max: 64

percentRepairedPerAction.//: How much the item is repaired per action. By default 33.33%, so 3 of 'repairCostMaterialAmount' fully repairs any item. min: 0, max: 1
